newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Luxembourg airline to resume flight to Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg airline to resume flight to Morocco.

text.p: Luxembourg airline Luxair will resume its weekly charter flight to the Moroccan southern city of Agadir, starting from December 1996, an official source said on Friday.
The flight will take place once a week, the source said but gave no details.
The company had evoked economic reasons blamed on the decline in number of visitors bound for Morocco to suspend its flights in 1992, the source said.
Since 1991 Gulf war, the number of foreign visitors has declined from 4.0 miliion to stagnate around 3.0 million annually, excluding North Africans, officials said.
Tourism receipts dropped to 9.9 billion dirhams ($1.15 billion) in 1995, from 11.3 billion dirhams ($1.31 billion) in the previous year, the finance ministry said.
More than 50 charter companies service Morocco, mainly the southern tourist cities of Agadir and Marrakesh and the northern city of Tangier.
